cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've crossed out today like you. That's our anniversary booking cancelled. Could you ring the restaurant as well?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I cross off days as they pass. You still need to cancel the table. What's happened?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, the phone part. Could that be the first thing you take off me? The number's on the fridge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call. Shall I ask for another date?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say no for me. Then stay while I put the anniversary glasses away; you can tell me about your day.

reason: Make copied confidence create a specific misunderstanding in the same emotional task; preserve B contribution and avoid turning vulnerable requests into rubric explanations.
